snippet.title: Cosmi: Forbidden Forest & Beyond - Re-Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Cosmi: Forbidden Forest & Beyond

Sharpshooters will love Forbidden Forest’s action, with this package including a medieval-styled remake of the original game, so that you can live that bardcore life, as well as digital comic book stories, box art, and bonus material so you can go behind the scenes, too. Forbidden Forest and Beyond the Forbidden Forest are joined in the collection by Aztec Challenge, Caverns of Khafka, Seal, Delta Man, Chomp!, Chernobyl: Nuclear Power Plant Simulation, Spite & Malice, and Navcom 6: The Persian Gulf Defense.

Cosmi: Forbidden Forest & Beyond will be released on Windows PC via Steam and GOG, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 5.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230790/Cosmi_Forbidden_Forests/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/cosmi_forbidden_forests
Ziggurat.games: http://www.ziggurat.games/game/cosmi-forbidden-forests
